data.label: exclude
data.reason_zh: 该方法以一次排序目标训练策略生成评分量表，属单轮训练而非多轮自改进。

scope_support.exclusion_quote: the judge is consulted only to train the rubric generator, while solving is trained against the agent's own rubric scores
scope_support.feedback_quote: a ranking objective against verified outcomes then trains rubric generation so that the criteria track genuine subtask success
scope_support.object_quote: SERA (Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents) turns evaluation into a learned capability of the policy itself.
scope_support.persistence_quote: the learned rubric doubles as an inference-time selector for tree search
